module: Vehicle telemetry tracker. It records which vehicles are spawned (`vehicleSpawned` event), driven and for how long (`vehicleUsed` activity), and resets (`vehicleReset` event). Custom configurations are reported as ":custom" instead of the configuration contents. Relies on `telemetry_core`, `telemetry_vehicleInfo` and `telemetry_configManager`.
notes: Only player 0 is tracked (`player ~= 0` is ignored in onVehicleSwitched). `newId == -1` means the player is no longer in a vehicle.
Resets are the noisiest event: `trackVehReset` does nothing if the `vehicle` module config has `trackResets == false`.
After a Lua reload, onVehicleSwitched does not fire again; onExtensionLoaded therefore reopens the activity of the vehicle currently driven.
`trackVehReset` is not called by any hook in this file: the caller is external (inferred from code).

dependencies.desc: Extensions to load before this one: `{'telemetry_core'}`.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is spawned. Sends the `vehicleSpawned` event with the model, configuration and current level. Does nothing if the vehicle info cannot be found.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes. For player 0, closes the current `vehicleUsed` activity then opens one for the new vehicle (or only closes it if newId is -1).

newId.desc: ID of the new vehicle, -1 if the player is no longer in a vehicle.

trackVehReset.desc: Sends the `vehicleReset` event (model and damage of player 0's vehicle, read from `map.objects[vid].damage`). Can be disabled via `trackResets = false` in the `vehicle` module config. Ignored if the player has no vehicle.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the mission/level on the client side. Closes the `vehicleUsed` activity.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Sets the extension to manual unload and, if player 0 is already driving a vehicle, opens its `vehicleUsed` activity.

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game exits. Closes the `vehicleUsed` activity.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded (a Lua reload does not go through onExit). Closes the `vehicleUsed` activity.
